description: Backend foundation and admin surface: new Event and EventRegistration Mongoose models, all admin and member API routes for events, the admin Events UI page, and the email notification function. This FEAT is self-contained — no changes to app/members/dashboard/page.tsx.
steps: 1. Create lib/models/Event.ts. Interface IEvent: title(string,required), description(string,required), date(Date,required,index), location(string,required), registrationFee(number,required,default:0), isFree(boolean,required,default:true), maxAttendees(number,optional), status(string,enum:['Draft','Published','Cancelled','Completed'],default:'Draft',index), createdBy(Schema.Types.ObjectId,ref:'Admin',required). Add { timestamps:true }. Use guard: const Event:Model<IEvent>=models.Event||mongoose.model<IEvent>('Event',EventSchema); export default Event.

2. Create lib/models/EventRegistration.ts. Interface IEventRegistration: eventId(ObjectId,ref:'Event',required,index), applicantId(ObjectId,ref:'Applicant',required,index), memberId(ObjectId,ref:'Member',required,index), fullName(string,required), email(string,required,lowercase), membershipNumber(string,required), paymentStatus(string,enum:['unpaid','paid','free'],default:'unpaid',index), paymentRef(string,sparse), paidAt(Date,optional), registeredAt(Date,default:Date.now,index), eventCardRef(string,unique,sparse). Add compound index { eventId:1, applicantId:1 } with { unique:true }. Use same model guard.
3. Extend lib/models/Notification.ts: add 'new_event' to the type enum in both the INotification interface ('new_registration'|'payment_received'|'new_event'|'general') and the Schema enum array.

4. Create app/api/admin/events/route.ts. GET: getAdminSession()->401; connectDB(); events=await Event.find({}).sort({date:-1}).lean(); for each event, count=await EventRegistration.countDocuments({eventId:e._id}); return {success:true,events: events.map(e=>({...e,registrationCount:counts[i]}))}. POST: getAdminSession()->401; parse body {title,description,date,location,registrationFee,isFree,maxAttendees,status}; validate title/description/date/location required; create event with registrationFee:isFree?0:registrationFee*100 (convert naira to kobo); save; Notification.create({type:'new_event',title:'New Event Created',message:`New event created: ${title}`,link:'/admin/dashboard/events'}); return {success:true,event}.

5. Create app/api/admin/events/[id]/route.ts. GET: auth; connectDB(); event=Event.findById(id)->404; count=EventRegistration.countDocuments({eventId:id}); return {event,registrationCount}. PATCH: auth; connectDB(); updated=Event.findByIdAndUpdate(id,{...body},{new:true,runValidators:true}); return {success:true,event:updated}. DELETE: auth; connectDB(); event=Event.findById(id)->404; if event.status!=='Draft' return 400 {error:'Only Draft events can be deleted'}; Event.findByIdAndDelete(id); return {success:true}.

7. Create app/api/member/events/route.ts. GET: getMemberSession()->401; connectDB(); member=Member.findById(session.memberId)->404; applicant=member.applicantId?Applicant.findById(member.applicantId):null; events=Event.find({status:'Published'}).sort({date:1}).lean(); for each event, reg=EventRegistration.findOne({eventId:e._id,applicantId:applicant?._id}).lean(); return {success:true,events:events.map(e=>({...e,isRegistered:!!reg,registrationId:reg?._id?.toString(),paymentStatus:reg?.paymentStatus}))}.

8. Create app/api/member/events/[id]/register/route.ts. POST: getMemberSession()->401; connectDB(); member=Member.findById(session.memberId)->404; applicant=Applicant.findById(member.applicantId)->403 if missing or status!=='Approved'; event=Event.findById(id)->404 if missing or status!=='Published'; existing=EventRegistration.findOne({eventId:id,applicantId:applicant._id})->409 if found. totalCount=await EventRegistration.countDocuments({eventId:id}); eventCardRef=`EVT/${id.toString().slice(-4)}/${new Date().getFullYear()}/${String(totalCount+1).padStart(4,'0')}`. If event.isFree: create EventRegistration with paymentStatus:'free'; call sendEventRegistrationConfirmation(non-blocking try/catch); return {success:true,registrationId:reg._id}. If paid: init Paystack with amount:event.registrationFee, reference:eventCardRef, callback_url:`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/members/dashboard?tab=events&payment=success`; create EventRegistration with paymentStatus:'unpaid',eventCardRef; return {success:true,authorizationUrl}.

9. Create app/api/member/events/[id]/verify-payment/route.ts. GET with ?reference=: getMemberSession()->401; connectDB(); secretKey=process.env.PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY; paystackRes=fetch(`https://api.paystack.co/transaction/verify/${encodeURIComponent(reference)}`,{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${secretKey}`}}); txn=data.data; if txn.status==='success': reg=EventRegistration.findOne({eventCardRef:reference})->404; update reg: paymentStatus='paid',paymentRef=txn.reference,paidAt=new Date(txn.paid_at); save; find Event for reg.eventId; sendEventRegistrationConfirmation (non-blocking); return {success:true}. Else return {success:false,status:'failed'}.

10. Create app/api/member/events/[id]/registration-card/route.ts. GET: getMemberSession()->401; connectDB(); member=Member.findById(session.memberId); reg=EventRegistration.findOne({eventId:id,memberId:member._id})->404; if reg.paymentStatus==='unpaid' return 403; event=Event.findById(reg.eventId)->404; return {eventTitle:event.title,eventDate:event.date,eventLocation:event.location,fullName:reg.fullName,membershipNumber:reg.membershipNumber,eventCardRef:reg.eventCardRef}.

11. Create app/api/member/event-card/[registrationId]/route.ts. GET: getMemberSession()->401; connectDB(); member=Member.findById(session.memberId); reg=EventRegistration.findById(registrationId)->404; if reg.memberId.toString()!==member._id.toString() return 403; if reg.paymentStatus==='unpaid' return 403; event=Event.findById(reg.eventId)->404; return {eventTitle:event.title,eventDate:event.date,eventLocation:event.location,fullName:reg.fullName,membershipNumber:reg.membershipNumber,eventCardRef:reg.eventCardRef}.

12. Add sendEventRegistrationConfirmation() to lib/utils/email.ts. Signature: (email,fullName,eventTitle,eventDate,eventLocation,eventCardRef,dashboardUrl). Subject: `You're registered for ${eventTitle}!`. Body: use emailHeader('Events & Activities') helper; show event title, date formatted as toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{weekday:'long',year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'}), location, eventCardRef in a monospace box (same style as applicationRef box in sendApplicationConfirmation), CTA button linking to dashboardUrl. Footer: 'This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this email.' Match the HTML table-based layout of existing functions in the file.

13. Create app/admin/dashboard/events/page.tsx. 'use client'. State: activeTab('list'|'create'), events(array), loading, submitting, error, formData {title,description,date,location,feeNaira,isFree,maxAttendees,status}. Fetch GET /api/admin/events on mount and after create. Dark theme: page bg from layout (#0f1117), section headers 'text-white font-bold text-2xl', cards 'rounded-xl border' with style={{background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'}}. Tab bar: two tabs 'Events' / 'Create Event' using same active style as admin layout nav (background:'rgba(26,71,42,0.35)',boxShadow:'inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(26,71,42,0.5)'). Events list: table with columns Title/Date/Location/Fee/Status/Attendees/Actions. Status badges: Draft=gray(text-white/50 bg-white/10), Published=green(text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/20), Cancelled=red(text-red-400 bg-red-500/20), Completed=blue(text-blue-400 bg-blue-500/20). Delete button only shown when status==='Draft', calls DELETE /api/admin/events/[id]. Create form: all inputs styled with style={{background:'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)',color:'white'}} className='rounded-lg px-3 py-2 w-full text-sm'. Fee toggle: two buttons Free/Paid. Submit button: bg-[#1a472a] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors after all steps
POST /api/admin/events creates an event and a Notification of type 'new_event'
DELETE /api/admin/events/[id] returns 400 if event status is not 'Draft'
Admin dashboard sidebar shows 'Events' nav item linking to /admin/dashboard/events
Admin Events page renders both tabs with correct dark theme
verification: npm run build — must complete with exit code 0 and no TypeScript errors
npm run lint — must pass without errors
